entities.name: John Grigg, 2nd Baron Altrincham
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John Edward Poynder Grigg was a British writer, historian and politician. He was the 2nd Baron Altrincham from 1955 until he disclaimed that title under the Peerage Act on the day it received Royal Assent in 1963.
